proposed_widenings.name: DcSource.fixed_dc
proposed_widenings.justification: Magic-item activations can impose a literal fixed save DC that is not derived from the wielder's spell save DC, proficiency bonus, or an ability modifier.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Each target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or have the Charmed condition for 8 hours.

proposed_widenings.name: ActivatedAbilityMechanics.range
proposed_widenings.justification: Activated non-spell abilities need explicit targeting range metadata so target and area attachments do not trace as range Self by default.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You can take a Magic action to present the rod and command obedience from each creature of your choice that you can see within 120 feet of yourself.

notes: Did not author content JSON/Dhall because the current magic-item activation surface cannot encode the fixed DC 15 or the 120-foot targeting range honestly. Secondary residue remains even after those widenings: 'regards you as its trusted leader' and the 'contrary to its nature' break clause are DM-adjudicated semantics rather than current deterministic surface fields.
